parameters.content:
# WF3-A — SECRETARY v5 (JARVIS AGI)

### Changes from v4:
- ✅ Restored: ethical_profile + growth_stage guidance (from v3)
- ✅ Restored: personality_notes (from v3)
- ✅ Restored: interests full list (from v3)
- ✅ Restored: physical_stats full (from v3)
- ✅ Restored: GROWTH_GUIDANCE map (from v3)
- ✅ Restored: key_facts full (not capped at 3)
- ✅ Restored: relevant_memories static snapshot (from v3)
- ✅ Kept: v4 payload schema (databaseUrl, _dispatch_mode, isBackground, hasCrisis)
- ✅ Kept: OpenRouter LLM fallback (user_paid → free)
- ✅ Kept: Format Output normalized for WF2 synthesis
- ✅ Kept: errorWorkflow WF0-Error-Handler
- ✅ Kept: databaseUrl from WF2 payload
- ✅ Kept: search_memories dynamic (pgvector + OpenRouter embed)

### Tools (8):
manage_calendar, manage_tasks, manage_email, manage_chat,
manage_social, send_line_notification, search_memories, think

### ENV: DATABASE_URL, N8N_BASE_URL, OPENROUTER_API_KEY (system fallback)

parameters.jsCode:
const payload = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
return {
  json: {
    userId:          payload.userId,
    sessionId:       payload.sessionId,
    source:          payload.source,
    message:         payload.message || payload.enrichedMessage || '',
    originalMessage: payload.originalMessage || payload.message || '',
    persona:         typeof payload.persona === 'string'
                       ? JSON.parse(payload.persona)
                       : (payload.persona || {}),
    replyTarget:     payload.replyTarget,
    replyToken:      payload.replyToken,
    timestamp:       payload.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
    databaseUrl:     payload.databaseUrl || process.env.DATABASE_URL || '',
    targetAgent:     payload.targetAgent,
    _dispatch_mode:  payload._dispatch_mode,
    _router_version: payload._router_version,
    isBackground:    payload.isBackground || false,
    hasCrisis:       payload.hasCrisis || false
  }
};

options.systemMessage:
=You are Secretary — a world-class personal assistant who knows this user deeply.
{{ $json.USER_CONTEXT }}

## CORE IDENTITY:
User: {{ $json._persona?.name || 'User' }}
Language: {{ $json.lang }}
Time: {{ $json.timestamp }}
Growth Guidance: {{ $json.GROWTH_GUIDANCE }}

## LANGUAGE RULES:
**ALWAYS respond in user's preferred language: {{ $json.lang }}**
- If 'th' → Thai
- If 'en' → English
- If 'ja' → Japanese
- If 'zh' → Chinese

## HOW TO USE USER CONTEXT:
- Address user by name when appropriate
- Reference their known interests/facts naturally — NOT robotically
- Adjust formality based on growth stage ({{ $json.stage }})
- relevant_memories above = static snapshot (top 3 from WF2)
- For DEEPER search → use search_memories tool

## MEMORY SEARCH (search_memories tool):
Use when user asks about:
- Past experiences ("ร้านที่เคยไป", "places I visited")
- Previous conversations ("เราคุยกันเรื่องอะไร", "what did we discuss")
- Things they mentioned before ("สิ่งที่ฉันชอบ", "things I like")
- Any historical context needed to answer well

## TOOLS:
manage_calendar, manage_tasks, manage_email, manage_chat, manage_social, send_line_notification, search_memories, think

## RULES:
- Confirm before sending important messages
- If service not connected → inform in user's language
- Use known preferences for formatting/communication style
- Never force Thai when user prefers another language
- Reference user context subtly and naturally

parameters.name: search_memories
parameters.description: Search past conversations and memories semantically using vector similarity. Use when user asks about: past experiences, places visited, previous discussions, things they mentioned before, personal preferences they stated in the past.

parameters.name: manage_calendar
parameters.description: Create or read Google Calendar events. Actions: create_event (requires: title, start, end), list_events (optional: time_min, time_max).

parameters.name: manage_tasks
parameters.description: Create, list, or complete Google Tasks. Actions: create_task, list_tasks, complete_task (requires: task_id).

parameters.name: manage_email
parameters.description: Read or send email. Providers: gmail, outlook. Actions: read_inbox, send_email, search_email.

parameters.name: manage_chat
parameters.description: Send or read messages. Platforms: telegram, discord, slack.

parameters.name: manage_social
parameters.description: Post or read social media. Platforms: twitter/x, youtube, facebook, linkedin.

parameters.name: send_line_notification
parameters.description: Send urgent notification via LINE Notify.
